title: The RIGHT function: the last characters
summary: RIGHT returns a number of characters from the end of a text.
intro: `RIGHT` takes the last characters of a text, such as the category letter at the end of a code.
args: The text, or a reference to a cell holding text.
How many characters; the default is 1.
examples: The last character of the second shipment code.
errors: The number of characters is negative.

faq.q: What if I ask for more characters than the text has?
faq.a: `RIGHT` returns the whole text, without an error.
